summary: Atomic selected-lead batch edits and private Firebase Storage lead attachments with current permissions, immutable retry, cleanup and release privacy checks.

api.reason: Contract1.16 adds atomic batch preview/apply and private file reservation/binary upload/list/download/versioned removal with explicit scopes, limits, idempotency and permission checks.
api.permissions: Current active membership and effective lead scope on every route and after Storage I/O. Read files needs leads:read; file/batch writes need leads:edit; reassignment additionally needs assignments:write. PATs need new explicit bulk/file scopes. Direct Storage clients remain denied.
